description: Set an eXO salt chlorinator’s output (chlorine production) percentage, 0–100. eXO systems only. Unlike the other controls this write is NOT in the iaqualink-py reference client — its shape is inferred from the reported `swc` field — so it is confirmed only if a re-read shows the new value. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE).

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

name: iaqualink_set_chlorinator
